IN THE UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
                            FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA
                                       Alexandria Division


MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE                             )
                                                   )
                                                   )
               Plaintiff,                          )
                                                   )
v.                                                 )   Civil Action No. 1:26-cv-2331-(RDA/IDD)
                                                   )
KATIE HALL, et al.,                                )
                                                   )
                                                   )
               Defendants.                         )
                                                   )

                                              ORDER
       This matter is before the Court on Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to File Second Amended

and Supplemental Complaint Pursuant to Federal Rules of Civil Procedure 15(a)(2) and 15(d) and

Request for Expedited Determination on the Papers (“Motion”) [Dkt. No. 59]. Upon consideration

of the Motion and the Proposed Amended Complaint [Dkt. Nos. 59-1, 60-1], this Court finds that

it does not possess sufficient information to issue an Order on this matter. Accordingly, it is hereby

       ORDERED that Plaintiff must provide a redlined version of the Amended Complaint [Dkt.

Nos. 59-1, 60-1], no later than September 11, 2026. This redlined version of the Amended

Complaint must clearly indicate the changes, deletions, and additions that were made to Plaintiff’s

Complaint [Dkt. No. 1].

        ENTERED this 9th day of September 2026.
                                                                          /s/
                                                              Ivan D. Davis
       Alexandria, Virginia                                   United States Magistrate Judge
